A '''clone trooper commando''' who wore [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] served as the leader of the [[High Orbit Precision Entry Squad]], also known as the H.O.P.E. Squad. He and his squad were sent to [[Mission to Yorn Skot|assist]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Treetower]] on [[Yorn Skot]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Treetower had been attempting to capture a shipment of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] goods from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], but had been unsuccessful and had been left trapped on a unipod under a landing platform. The [[Commando/Legends|commando]] and his men rappelled down the side of the platform to retrieve the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but were attacked by a group of [[B2-AA air assault super battle droid|jump droids]]. The droids [[Death/Legends|killed]] the entire unit with the exception of the [[Clone commando/Legends|leader]] who managed to rescue Treetower and destroy the droids. Safely back on the platform, Treetower revealed to the commando that the smuggled goods were actually [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] who had been captured and who were going to be sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].
